fields.description: A domain the site is served under, e.g. acme.sites.example.com.
fields.label: Domain

fields.description: Pending: its DNS records are not published or seen yet. Active: attached to the site through Frappe Cloud's proxy. Failed: Pilot could not attach it.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The site's own links and redirects use this domain. Change it with Make Primary.
fields.label: Primary

fields.description: It did not answer over HTTPS within minutes of being attached, so the site kept its own host name. Make it primary once it serves HTTPS.
fields.label: Not Made Primary

fields.description: Suite Cloud publishes this domain's records itself.
fields.label: Managed

fields.description: The CNAME and TXT records Pilot asks for, as last fetched.
fields.label: DNS Records

fields.description: When the DNS records were last read from Pilot. They are read again after 23 hours, since Central keeps a verification token for 24.
fields.label: Records Fetched At

fields.description: The Pilot task attaching the domain, while it runs.
fields.label: Pilot Task

fields.description: Why the domain is not attached yet, e.g. Central does not see its records, or why it was not made primary.
fields.label: Failure Reason
